digitalEngine.name: CircuitBench event logic
digitalEngine.execution: JavaScript · isolated Web Worker · fresh instance per run
digitalEngine.initialization: Combinational logic settles at time zero; flip-flops, registers and counters use their explicit initial state.
digitalEngine.simultaneousInputs: All driver changes at one timestamp resolve together. Rising-edge state elements sample the resulting inputs; register and counter words update atomically.
digitalEngine.sequentialControls: Register/counter reset and enable are synchronous and active high; reset wins. Ambiguous edges or controls retain only bit values common to every possible outcome.
digitalEngine.limitations: No setup/hold, metastability, drive strengths, HDL, or analog feedback coupling.

engine.name: CircuitBench event logic
engine.execution: JavaScript · isolated Web Worker · fresh instance per run
engine.initialization: Combinational logic settles at time zero; flip-flops, registers and counters use their explicit initial state.
engine.simultaneousInputs: All driver changes at one timestamp resolve together. Rising-edge state elements sample the resulting inputs; register and counter words update atomically.
engine.sequentialControls: Register/counter reset and enable are synchronous and active high; reset wins. Ambiguous edges or controls retain only bit values common to every possible outcome.
engine.limitations: No setup/hold, metastability, drive strengths, HDL, or analog feedback coupling.

limitations: WASM was compiled without XSPICE; digital events come from the explicit CircuitBench kernel.

ADC crossing timing is reconstructed between recorded analog samples at 1 ps event resolution.
DAC X/Z inputs are rejected; no drive-strength, metastability, setup/hold or HDL claim.
Full truth tables cover at most 8 selected constant input bits and 32 output columns in a pure combinational circuit; they do not replace transient hazard analysis.
